chapter: Giving up and returning to music
title: Walter Nelson gets him playing again
summary: After marriage he meets steel guitarist Walter Nelson, buys a second-hand outfit and plays a trio job with Ed Moran.

story.theme_name: Making a living: hard times, day jobs and scarce work
story.community_name: Day jobs: musicians working outside music

blocks.x: So I sold my outfit I had. Yeah. So after I got married and moved down here, I was over across the street at 825. Yeah. Well that was during the days of Mo Rambles, Mo Rambles, who had Mo Rambles, I know who heard of him. Oh yeah. The trumpet player. Well Walter Nelson, he's down here at the Piku's place, he plays steel guitar. Yeah. Him and I had met one night up on Bama Street by some friends of ours and he was playing his guitar and I was passing my foot in tempo with him, you know. He said, Joe, do you ever play music? I said, yeah, I play drums. I said, I used to play drums but I don't play it now. I said, because business has been kind of bad and I just sold my drums and gave up.

He said, why don't you start back again? I said, I don't have no outfit to start with. He said, well, the Rambles one, or buy a second handed outfit. He said, I can always use a drummer. I said, well, all right. So I went somewhere and bought a second hand outfit piece by piece, you know. Yeah. And he started getting a few little jobs lined up. So one night him and Moran and myself played back in Gentilek, three pieces. Well, I played so well that night after being off for so many years. And I said, well, Ed Moran told me, he said, Joey, you go stick with them drums. I said, I'm going to try. He said, don't give them up. He said, hang on to him. He said, we'll get enough working with a larger band as we go along. I said, well, all right, whoever, I said, I'll hold on to him. Well, I was working in the daytime there at the bank. I switched from night porter to day porter. I said, well, I'll hold on to him until I get a better outfit.
So sure enough, we started getting plenty of work and we enlarged the band. What year was this about?
